# Bundled Windows OpenSSH client

This folder contains the Windows OpenSSH client files used by Remote Dev Terminal.
The files are copied from the Windows 11 in-box OpenSSH Client distribution and
report version `OpenSSH_9.5p2 for Windows` (`9.5.6.2`). The matching upstream
`LICENSE.txt` and `NOTICE.txt` are included here.

Only the client tools are packaged. Remote Dev Terminal does not install or run
the OpenSSH server service.
